summary: Iter 30 RETEST of the 2 backend bugs from iter 29 (notifications 500 + approve-form scope ownership). Re-ran the existing comprehensive pytest suite test_iteration29_payment_method_form_approval.py: 14/14 PASS (was 12/14 in iter 29). (1) GET /api/notifications now returns 200 with form_submission entries — server.py:3402-3431 and 3489-3518 use defensive .get() and 'if not end_str: continue' guards before subscript access. (2) approve_form_submission (server.py:2237) and reject_form_submission (server.py:2254) now call `await assert_scope_ownership(current_user, 'companies', company)` after the existence check; sales user with scope=own attempting to approve admin's company correctly receives 403 'Bu əməliyyat üçün icazəniz yoxdur'. Regression checks all pass: payment_method persists in expenses (Köçürmə/Nəğd/Posterminal/CTC), incomes, companies/finance payment_history, sales-leads/payment payment_history; public form submit writes only to pending_form_data (main fields untouched); approve-form moves pending → real fields and clears pending_*; reject-form clears pending_form_data, sets status='Rədd edildi' with reject_reason; both 400 when no pending data. Frontend smoke (admin login, viewport 1920x1080): GET /api/notifications fetched in-page returned 200, Companies page loads cleanly, Finance → Xərclər tab → 'Xərc əlavə et' modal renders with [data-testid='expense-payment-method'] Select for Ödəniş üsulu. Zero /api/ errors observed during the full UI walkthrough.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:3512 still uses c['brand_name'] and c['contract_end_date'] directly inside the membership_expired branch — currently safe because of the prior 'if not end_str: continue' guard and the projection includes both fields, but for parity with the rest of the function consider switching to c.get(...). Not a blocker.

submit_public_form (server.py:2213) accepts an untyped dict; an attacker could spam keys (mitigated since only enabled-field keys are written to pending_form_data). Consider Pydantic typing in a future iteration.
approve-form/reject-form return generic strings ({'message': '...'}); returning the updated company doc would let SPA refresh in one round-trip and avoid a follow-up GET.

Companies.jsx table variant uses inline 📩 emoji span without a testid; only the card variant has pending-badge-{id}. Consider data-testid='pending-row-{id}' on the table 📩 for E2E parity (carry-over from iter 29).

rca of the issue: Iter 29 reported (1) Mongo $ne semantics also match docs missing the field, causing KeyError on direct subscript access in the notifications builder; and (2) approve-form/reject-form enforced only module-level permission via Depends(check_permission('companies','write')) without row-level assert_scope_ownership. Iter 30 verified the two patches: defensive .get()+continue guards in the notifications builder (server.py:3402-3431 and 3489-3518), and `await assert_scope_ownership(current_user, 'companies', company)` calls inserted at server.py:2242 (approve) and 2259 (reject). Both pytest cases that previously failed now pass.
